## Before You Start
- [ ] Changes are in a feature branch (not `main`)
- [ ] Tested locally by opening HTML files in a browser
- [ ] Checked links work (internal links should be relative)

## What Changed?
<!-- Describe your changes -->

## Type of Change
- [ ] Content update (text, images, prices)
- [ ] New page or article
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Styling/CSS change

## Checklist
- [ ] All pages have meta description tag
- [ ] All pages have Plausible analytics script
- [ ] All pages have favicon link
- [ ] sitemap.xml updated if pages were added/removed
- [ ] Phone number is correct in any new forms (`0434 694 141`)
- [ ] SMS order buttons use `data-wa-product` attribute
- [ ] Images are compressed (under 500KB preferred)
